clue.title: A German timetable
clue.text: At a cold German camp, a torn page: a train timetable, Cairo to Alexandria, with the night express underlined twice. The Germans mean to leave Cairo by rail.

trail_italians.desc: Tyre tracks on the coast road

clue.title: Truck parts
clue.text: A crate of truck parts stencilled 'Ricambi Ferraro', dumped by the coast road. The Italians' trucks are failing; in Cairo they'll need repairs and a police permit to move cargo out of the city.
